import pixeltable as pxt

# Define and register the custom function
@pxt.udf
def word_count(text: str) -> int:
    """Count the number of words in a text string."""
    if not text:
        return 0
    return len(text.split())

# Get the existing docs table
docs = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Add the computed column that automatically derives n_words from content
docs.add_column(
    name='n_words',
    value=word_count(docs.content)
)
